purpose: Represent real products that are manufactured, cut, mixed, assembled or engineered to a project configuration rather than selected as a fixed retail SKU.

commerce.unit: each | m | m2 | m3 | kg | tonne | project

logistics.delivery_mode: parcel | pallet | ltl | full_truck | mixer_truck | crane_truck | specialist | pickup | other

examples: Ready-mix concrete: family + engineered mix specification + batching plant + m3 + pour date + mixer-truck sequence.
Window system: profile family + exact opening dimensions + glazing + hardware + finish + fabrication shop.
Kitchen: cabinet system + module schedule + fronts + hardware + worktop fabrication.
Stone: slab/lot + cut schedule + finish + edge treatment + fabricator.
principle: The canonical Twin can be a real configured project product even when no single fixed SKU exists before engineering or quotation.
